title: It's Okay, but the Pump Design Needs Improvement
text:
It's Okay, but the Pump Design Needs Improvement. Permanent liquid soap dispensers are nice to have around. They are refillable and they cut down on costs because you can purchase a larger bottle of soap and save money per ounce. For this reason, I was happy to give the InterDesign Midi Soap Pump Caddy a try. It seemed like a nice addition to the kitchen, next to the sink, so I loaded it with liquid soap and put it to use.

From the outside, this dispenser has a nice appearance. The brushed nickel is attractive and I like that the soap dispenser is clear and completely see- through because that means I will know when the soap is about to run out. The two caddy holders are nice, too, because they can be used to store sponges and other items, for easy access.

As for the soap dispenser itself, it does look nice, but I have issues with the design that convince me to lower my overall rating. The greatest problem I have is with the dispensing mechanism. You press down to release soap and it returns to its normal position, which is expected, but the problem is that there is not enough space to press down. The pump needs to be re-designed to elevate it higher above the base. This would allow for more clearance and result in the right amount of liquid soap getting dispensed. The way it works now, you have to place your hands very close to the base and, with so little space, a single pump dispenses only a small amount of soap, and to the edge of your hand. It would be better if the nozzle was not only higher up, but also if it stretched further from the base in order to deposit the soap closer to the middle of the hand.

If you can get past the frustration with dispensing, you will find that the InterDesign Midi Soap Pump Caddy is a decent product. It makes an attractive enough addition to the kitchen and it has enough weight that it doesn’t require holding the base in order to use, like many of the plastic bottles do. It holds enough soap that it should go far between refills and it does have added compartments for storing other items, even if they are not all that large. Still, it’s difficult to ignore the dispensing design and I can understand why so many people rate this below average. I’m going to be more understanding and give this product 3 stars, but the manufacturer should definitely spend time on making what should be simple improvements.
